A superseded read that lands last replaces the current answer. The default arm and the wizard show the previous record's values under the new `recordId` (measured; the drawer, modal, split and tabbed arms are the guarded control). `LookupField`, the people picker and `RecordPickerDialog` show results for an earlier query (measured by `renderHook`). A form or picker that shows the wrong record's data answers wrong ⇒ p2, as objectui#10684.

## ✅ ACCEPT: objectui#10723 (PR 1 of 2) at `04a8bbc`

`domain:ui` seat 5, `session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`, 2026-09-25T22:01Z. Checked against the diff and CI, not against the report's own account.


| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| record values | the default arm and `WizardForm` get the effect-local `cancelled` flag the four guarded arms already carry, in `DrawerForm`'s shape line for line. The values, `loadedRecordRef`, `run.commit()`, `run.fail()` and the `finally`'s `loading` release all sit behind it |
| schema census | each of the six layouts had one `setObjectSchema` after an awaited `getObjectSchema`, and all six raced at the base. All six are now guarded, as is the default arm's inline-members fallback. The dispatcher's `sections[].group` read already carried an `alive` flag |
| `useRecordQuery` | a run-sequence ref, numbered after the cannot-query return. Only the latest call commits `records` / `total` / `error` and ends `loading`. That covers the debounced search, the page / sort effect, `toggleSort` / `setSort` and `refetch` |
| two guards agree | `cancelled` flips in run N's cleanup, and `beginLoadRun` numbers run N+1 in its body with no await between. So both guards supersede a run at the same instant. The flag is checked before every failure-slot write, and `loadFailure.ts` is the same blob as at the base |
| `loading` | every early return runs before an await, so it cannot be superseded, and the current run always ends `loading`. Nothing new can leave a form on its skeleton |
| claim limits | `LineItemsPanel.tsx` / `MasterDetailForm.tsx` untouched (PR 2). No dependency list moves, and no export, prop or accept set moves |
| pins | `supersededReads-10712.test.tsx` covers the six layouts through `object-form`, and `useRecordQuery.supersededAnswer-10712.test.tsx` covers the three callers plus the orderings. Every read is settled by hand, and there is a lit control per layout. 21 of the cases are red at the base. No existing pin is edited |
| contract review | **PASS** at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head, record `5840264455` on the PR. The seat read the reviewer transcript: every turn was at tier |
| clause ② | `no` holds |
| semver | `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/fields`. Every changeset sentence reads true |
| governed | NOT GOVERNED (11 paths) |
| CI | 3 skipped, 40 success, 0 red on `04a8bbc` |
| closing keywords | the body carries `Refs #10712` and no closing keyword. `Fixes #10712` rides PR 2 |

### Carried into PR 2 (`Fixes #10712`, after PR objectui#10650), not blocking PR 1

- `LineItemsPanel`'s load, measured first.
- `useRecordQuery`, in the same hook and family:
  - A read in flight when `enabled` goes false still commits after the disable reset. The sibling case, `objectName` / `dataSource` going null, has no reset at all.
  - The debounced search timer closes over the `runQuery` it was armed with, so a filter or object change inside the debounce window lets the older closure's call be numbered latest.
- `WizardForm` not returning to its loading state on a record swap is a different mechanism (the `recordSwapLoading` defect). It goes to the filing gate as its own card.

### State

`ready` and auto-merge (squash) go through the relay ops `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in this act. The card stays open for PR 2, and `pm:dispatched` stays on it.
